info.title: AIQ Scoring API (Answer Labs proprietary product object)
info.description:
Answer Labs Inc. hosted AIQ scoring endpoint. Available to institutional partners on request.

BOUNDARY, NORMATIVE. The AIQResponse object returned by this endpoint is a proprietary product object. It is NOT a Learning Provenance Record and it is NOT an SLPT-conformant record. It does not carry intended_use, use_authorization_status or validation_status, and it therefore cannot express, satisfy or establish the credential gate in rule R5 of schema/lpr_v1.2.0.json. A response from this endpoint establishes nothing about SLPT conformance.

SLPT conformance is determined only by validating a Learning Provenance Record against schema/lpr_v1.2.0.json. Where a platform serialises an LPR from data returned here, that LPR is subject to R1-R6 in its own right, and a credential_tier in it is conformant only where credentialing use has reached a validation-gated authorization state with populated evidence attached. No completed validation study exists at this release.

The vocabulary below is the product vocabulary and deliberately differs from the schema: dimension_scores here is not dimension_estimates in the LPR, and aiq_credential and proficiency_band have no counterpart in the schema and carry no validated interpretation. Contact tech@answerr.ai to discuss access.

The path name /v1/slpt/aiq is a product endpoint name. It does not imply that AIQResponse is SLPT-conformant.

post.summary: Score a learner session and return a proprietary AIQ product object
post.description: Returns an AIQResponse. This is a product object, not a Learning Provenance Record, and not an SLPT-conformant credential. See the boundary statement in info.description.

200.description: AIQResponse returned. Not an LPR; establishes no SLPT conformance.

example._note: proficiency_band above is NOT VALIDATED and this object is not an SLPT-conformant credential.

400.description: Invalid request — missing required fields or malformed payload

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden — institution not authorized for this endpoint

university_id.description: Unique identifier for the institution or enterprise partner.

api_key.description: API key generated from the Answerr educator dashboard.

config.description: Institutional configuration for this scoring request.

weights.description: Dimension weights configurable at the institutional level. Contact tech@answerr.ai to discuss configuration.

SOD.description: Source and Output Discernment weight — configurable, disclosed to the deploying institution

AD.description: Adaptability weight — configurable, never applied to elapsed time

token_thresholds.description: Minimum token usage thresholds for each credential tier. Configurable by institutional partners.

learner.description: Token threshold for AIQ Learner — configurable

certified.description: Token threshold for AIQ Certified — configurable

passing_scores.description: Minimum passing scores for each credential tier. Configurable by institutional partners.

learner.description: Passing score for AIQ Learner — configurable

certified.description: Passing score for AIQ Certified — configurable

lock_period_days.description: Number of days a credential is locked before re-assessment is permitted.

branding.description: Institutional branding applied to issued credentials.

institution_name.description: Full name of the institution or enterprise partner.

logo_url.description: URL of the institution logo for credential display.

session.description: Session data for the learner being scored.

course_id.description: Identifier of the course or programme this session belongs to.

tokens_used.description: Total tokens used by this learner in this session.

credential_tier.description: Credential tier awarded to the learner. PROPRIETARY PRODUCT VALUE: no validated interpretation, and not an LPR field.

aiq_credential.description: Composite AIQ credential score across the five SLPT dimensions. PROPRIETARY PRODUCT VALUE: no validated interpretation, and not an LPR field.

dimension_scores.description: Individual scores across the five SLPT dimensions. PROPRIETARY PRODUCT VALUE: no validated interpretation, and not an LPR field.

proficiency_band.description: Product band label. NOT VALIDATED: no completed validation study supports any band interpretation, and this object is not an SLPT-conformant credential. See info.description. PROPRIETARY PRODUCT VALUE: no validated interpretation, and not an LPR field.

credential_id.description: Unique identifier for the issued credential. PROPRIETARY PRODUCT VALUE: no validated interpretation, and not an LPR field.

valid_until.description: UTC timestamp of credential expiry based on lock_period_days.

institution_name.description: Name of the co-signing institution or enterprise partner.

methodology_id.description: Identifier of the scoring methodology version used. See §3 Principle 5 of the SLPT specification.
